t: That this Act may be cited as the “Navajo Community College Act.”

fable.w: This section is only a short-title provision naming the Act. The tempting reading is that the reference to a Navajo (tribal) community college implies tribal involvement, but the text sets out no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government.
fable.s: That this Act may be cited as the “Navajo Community College Act.”

opus.w: This is only a short-title clause naming the Act. It sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking or right to sue. A Navajo community college might seem to suggest tribal involvement, but the tribal name is just part of the title and describes no process for outside parties to take part in a federal decision.
